description: This file defines the X509CertificateCredential class, a data structure representing credentials for X.509 certificates, including a list of secrets and related methods.

classes.name: X509CertificateCredential
classes.description: A credential class for storing RFC 2253 formatted subject DN of a client certificate, extending CommonCredential.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of X509 certificate secrets used for device authentication.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of X509 certificate secrets; cannot be empty if non-null.
